verdict.rationale: SigNoz exposes a programmatic API used by service accounts, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows a published OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe of common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. Dashboard JSON export, llms.txt and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
